Sūtra.</ls> .{@-यः@} [अद्वयं विज्ञानाभेदः पदार्थानाम् अस्त्यस्य वादकत्वेन अस्त्यर्थे अच्] <ab>N.</ab> of Buddha .{@-यम्@} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] Non-duality, unity, identity; especially of Brahman and the universe, or of spirit and matter; the highest truth.
